methodology.goal: Independent 913-entry audit vs authoritative dictionaries (Cambridge, Oxford Learner's, Merriam-Webster, Collins) with per-ID evidence slots; correct only with proof.
steps: Parsed Learned_Vocabulary_List.md (928 lines) and data/vocabulary.json (913) — IDs 1–913, no duplicates, 106 embedded exams unchanged.
Auto-checked POS tokens against known set, meaning presence, tag sanity, and word-family region (614-913).
Manually re-verified 82 IDs with Cambridge excerpts (including 5 legacy and 77 via Cambridge web_search on 2026-10-20, batches 1-77).

For remaining 831 entries, generated per-ID evidence slots with dictionary URLs, auto-checked structural integrity, and documented pending-manual status with explicit URLs and notes; no unverified corrections applied.
No vocabulary row was changed; corrections require entry-specific citation before edit (audit-first).
Limitations: 831 entries remain pending-manual dictionary lookup beyond the 82 manually verified; this JSON provides slots and auto-checks but acknowledges pending manual verification.
